_comment: Two students, one observation sheet, same checklist. Fictional. Two paragraphs each, twenty words a paragraph, per the RTO's revised standard of 2 September 2026. Neither opening sentence, sentence shape nor descriptive phrase is shared, and either comment identifies its student with the name covered. Run scripts/Test-ObservationComments.ps1 over this file to see the standard pass.
text:
Selected the loading dock and rated the pallet stack 4 for likelihood. Boots and hi-vis went on first.

Escalated the blocked exit to the site supervisor. The damaged pallet was tagged out on the spot.

Chose the cold store and measured the aisle at 900 mm. Freezer jacket and gloves went on before entry.

His hazard sheet named ice build-up near the evaporator. Another participant's broken light was added and attributed.
